ruleDefinitions.name: A Rule Has Been Deleted From The Windows Firewall Exception List
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a single rules or all of the rules have been deleted from the Windows Defender Firewall Note: Unmapped fields: ModifyingApplication

sequences.query: (event_id = 2006 OR event_id = 2052) AND  NOT ((ModifyingApplication = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR ModifyingApplication = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR ModifyingApplication = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")) OR ModifyingApplication = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost\.exe" OR ModifyingApplication = "None" OR ModifyingApplication = "") AND  NOT ((ModifyingApplication = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Platform\\\\") AND ModifyingApplication = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$")))
